game_title: The Lost Legacy of C · C origins
game_concept: A adventure race set in Shadow Cave – Hidden Spring, a hidden spring: the cave miner must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Countdown Launch: Tick a countdown down each loop until it hits zero and the launch fires.
theme: Shadow Cave – Hidden Spring: a hidden spring
core_gameplay_loop: Search the archive, examine recovered computing artifacts, and use their evidence to verify the assigned C lesson.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Case 7: Find 5 artifacts, read the evidence, and verify three findings about C origins.
controls: Select objects in the room. Review discovered objects in Evidence and verify your findings. Tab and Enter select controls. Escape closes a card or pauses.
win_condition: Recover all 5 artifacts and answer all three evidence checks correctly.
lose_condition: The case ends when the available incorrect evidence checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared archive artwork, illustrated artifacts, and Kenney interface audio.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Countdown Launch' (Week 4 slot 2), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Hidden Spring'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Introduction to C: History, Characteristics and Classification

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Match the silhouettes in the tray to the objects in the room.
Inspect each artifact to read its history.
Open Evidence to review the records and verify your findings.
source_player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the ore lift by solving code steps involving count that move the cave miner forward.
source_win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.65).
source_lose_condition: The rival reaches the ore lift first, or lives reach 0.
hint: Match an unfound object in the tray to its shape in the room. The Evidence folder keeps every record you uncover.
